what: Verdicts of the original Julia check_coa_evidence_paths.jl (its own checkpath function) on a fixed fixture tree. The Python port, scripts/check_coa_evidence_paths.py, must give the same verdict for every input; its --self-test reads this file.
produced: 2026-10-20, Julia 1.12 on macOS, by including the original and calling checkpath(input, base) with base = a fresh folder holding the tree below
left_out: a differently-cased path ('shared folder/report.pdf'): it resolved as a file on macOS, whose filesystem ignores case, and would be missing on Linux, so it is not a portable verdict
